title: Power Automate: desktop flow libraries of reusable subflows
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and keeps undocumented library behaviour separate from documented template behaviour. Power Automate Premium supports the stated product-level entitlement; library-specific terms and controls remain unpublished in the searches checked. Minor corrections concern a missing source and checklist references not represented in the controls table.

claims.claim: Power Automate Premium provides the full set of desktop authoring capabilities.
claims.quote: We recommend the Power Automate Premium license for all users, as it gives them the full set of capabilities to create both API based and desktop automations.

claims.claim: The included licensing model represents the existing Power Automate Premium desktop authoring entitlement, not a published library-specific licence.
claims.quote: With a Power Automate Premium user license, users gain the full set of capabilities for cloud and desktop automation including premium connectors, process and task mining, AI Builder, use of managed environments, and Microsoft Dataverse storage.

claims.quote: confirm ... whether existing Flow checker rules and data policies apply to it. / No library-specific setting is documented, so the table has one row stating that gap.
claims.fix: Replace the At rollout bullet with 'Confirm which identity and connections a library subflow runs with.' This removes the checklist-only control references without adding unverified control rows.
